title: Master's Thesis: Deep Learning for Dose Prediction
description: Investigation of deep learning methods for dose prediction from sparse measurements in radiotherapy.
longDescription: Master's thesis in collaboration with PTW Freiburg. Built and benchmarked neural networks to predict radiation dose distributions from sparse input measurements, as an interdisciplinary feasibility study with a medical AI focus.
bullets: Built an end-to-end pipeline from raw measurements to evaluation
Worked with real clinical data and challenges

title: Fast Optimizer Benchmark (FOB)
description: Framework for benchmarking deep learning optimizers.
longDescription: Team project (3 members) at the University of Freiburg. Built a framework for systematic evaluation and comparison of deep learning optimizers across multiple model sizes and domains. Resulted in a workshop paper.

title: Deep Learning Lab: Uncertainty Estimation for Monocular Depth
description: Final project in the Deep Learning Lab on uncertainty estimation for monocular depth prediction.
longDescription: Hands-on graduate lab covering deep learning, reinforcement learning, and computer vision. Final project focused on modeling and evaluating uncertainty in monocular depth estimation.
bullets: Applied methods on real image data

title: Bachelor's Thesis: Distributed Graph Algorithms in the LogP Model
description: Designed and analyzed distributed algorithms in the LogP model.
longDescription: Bachelor's thesis at the University of Freiburg with a focus on theoretical computer science. Developed and analyzed distributed graph algorithms, including mathematical derivations and complexity analysis.

title: Procedural Tilemap Generation using Markov-Chain Wave Function Collapse
description: Tool for procedural tilemap generation in Unity.
longDescription: Bachelor project implementing a Markov-Chain Wave Function Collapse approach for procedural tilemap generation. Included algorithm implementation and in-engine visualization tooling.

title: Game Jams
description: Participated in multiple game jams with small teams.
longDescription: Weekend events where complete games were built in teams of roughly 2 to 10 people. Focused on rapid prototyping, collaboration, and automated build workflows for fast iteration.

title: MKDocs Learning Websites
description: Course-note websites built and hosted with MkDocs.
longDescription: Personal project to create and host lecture summaries for myself and fellow students using MkDocs and GitLab Pages, with content authored in Markdown.

title: Progress Tracker Web App
description: Web tool to track progress in an online game.
longDescription: Single-page application hosted on GitHub Pages and used by friends and me. Includes filtering, local persistence, and export/import support.
bullets: SPA with filtering and data export

title: Indie Game Development
description: Indie game developed in a two-person team.
longDescription: Ongoing project targeting a Steam release. Includes experimentation with reinforcement learning and containerized learning environments.
bullets: Game design and development in Godot
